text:
Jenna (Onboarding): quick capture from BrightWave onboarding call 11:45 PT — they surfaced 4 things. dropping raw notes + ask for triage.

Jenna (Onboarding): ```Customer asks:
1) Per-route cost breakdown in console (they want CSV export)
2) Embed caching TTL control (observability + settable)
3) Faster cold-start on small seqs (~<128) — they see 150-300ms spike
4) Allow per-team model pinning in org (admin UX)
```

Jenna (Onboarding): pain/context: migrating from competitor; finance exec worried about surprise billing; infra team dislikes current mem spikes on tiny requests. They flagged this as renewal gating if not addressed before EOM.

Sam (CS): thanks! can we rate these by "renewal risk" and "engineering effort"? quick votes: I'll +1 high risk for 1 & 3

Diane (PM): +1 to 1 (billing CSV) being high impact / low effort? Need eng estimate. Avik can you rough-effort 1-3?

Avik (Research): quick: 1 export UI + CSV backend ~2-3 dev days. 2 cache TTL control depends on runtime work — ~1 sprint. 3 cold-start fix might be kernel/runtime tuning + quantization profile — 2-4 sprints. 4 admin UX ~1 sprint. these are rough.

Nora (Support): logged related tickets: RWD-1234 (billing confusion), RWD-1235 (embed-caching), RWD-1236 (latency-spike). I pasted links in ticketing. customers asked for workarounds: set larger batch_size or pin model w/ shorter seq.

Diane (PM): ok I'll create an epic for renewal-risk items. Jenna can you attach full call transcript + sample logs to the epic? @Jenna (Onboarding)

Jenna (Onboarding): yes — uploading transcript to s3://redwood-onboard/brightwave/1764456799/transcript.txt and saving key logs. will attach and drop link in the epic.

Sam (CS): propose prioritization matrix: High risk / low effort => #1 billing export (move to sprint 1). High risk / medium/high effort => #3 cold-start (investigate perf before commit). Rest => backlog with owners. Anyone object? :thumbsup:

Diane (PM): :thumbsup: I'll schedule grooming Fri 10am. action items: Diane create epic + tickets; Jenna attach assets; Avik scope perf experiment; Nora surface to AE for renewal conversation.

CSBot: Reminder set — grooming meeting scheduled Fri 10:00 AM. :bell:

Sam (CS): thanks all. if someone can add quick AC for #1 (fields needed in CSV) that'd help — finance wants token-level, route, timestamp, cost columns.

Diane (PM): noted — AC for CSV: columns = timestamp, route_id, model, token_count, cost_usd, account_id. include download & scheduled export. adding to ticket.

Jenna (Onboarding): leaving notes in the epic. closing thread here — ping in product-triage if updates. :v:
